component.name: Waddle
component.summary: A focused local file explorer with Vim-style controls

description.p: Waddle is a Linux file explorer for local work. It combines conventional mouse and keyboard selection with a compact Vim-style browser grammar.
It supports desktop clipboard and drag-and-drop transfers, safe conflict handling, persistent undo, search, Trash, Recent, storage volumes, and file metadata actions.

ul.li: Refresh browser entries after partially failed Undo or Redo and preserve Recent, Trash, and pending navigation when operations finish.
Keep newer editors and command output when earlier file actions complete.
Keep file-action confirmations and Properties failures visible through automatic refreshes.
Refresh the original folder when recursive search is cancelled or submitted without matches.
Preserve search selections, context-menu targets, and Recent and Trash views across refreshes.
Keep newer command and Properties output when earlier requests finish.
Recover folder monitoring after replacements, notification overflow, and startup failures.
Keep large selections, Cut operations, and Trash confirmation responsive.
Improve symbolic-link handling, permission details, partial-delete feedback, and sidebar disk ordering.
Limit Tab navigation to files and Sidebar and restore keyboard focus after editing.
Keep marquee selection aligned with visible files after resizing and allow selection in Trash.
Finish file drags when released over empty space or toolbar widgets without duplicating transfers.
Clear the target hover state when an X11 drag is cancelled or rejected.
Allow Delete and black-hole deletion shortcuts in Trash to open permanent-delete confirmation.
Move focus to file entries when selecting all with Ctrl+A.
Show accurate guidance for unsupported Cut shortcuts in Trash.
Preserve selected sources before dependent Copy and Move writes, including conflicts and retries.
Protect access permissions, metadata, hardlinks, and recoverable transfer history when filesystem operations fail.
Keep same-folder copies independent through directory aliases and apply-to-all conflict choices.
Add delicate flat file icons while keeping folders in the active theme color.
Recover interrupted Copy, Move, Trash, and Restore Undo and Redo operations.
Detect source changes during copying and delayed storage errors before publishing copied files.
Preserve partial history and identify the correct Trash entry when original paths repeat.
Improve Copy, Move, Trash, and Restore progress, cancellation, conflict handling, and retry safety.
Preserve hardlinks and recover partial Undo and Redo operations across restarts.
Fix local Wayland clipboard transfers, delayed Paste destinations, and marquee selection focus.
Add portable font and icon choices, adjustable icon and label sizes, and clearer sidebar icons and arrows.
Show storage volumes in the sidebar with mount, unmount, and capacity controls.
Run Trash operations as Transfers with progress, cancellation, retry, and history.
Separate metadata warnings from file-operation errors and improve removable-drive Undo.
Add smooth wheel and touchpad scrolling with momentum.
Add configurable system theme icons.
Stop idle redraws and load system icons outside the UI thread.
Return control to the terminal while Waddle continues running.
Keep stationary clicks near grid edges from scrolling until marquee dragging starts.
Reveal the exact files requested by browsers and desktop integrations.
Preserve multi-selection for context menus and make Vim-style Trash and Cut flows more reliable.
Clip long sidebar folder names with an ellipsis and make hidden files more transparent.
Add Vim-style Ctrl+W directional focus and selected-file variables for shell commands.
Auto-scroll marquee selection at viewport edges while preserving its anchor and final scroll position.
Keep marquee borders aligned with the visible file area when selection extends beyond it.
Keep the interface responsive while slow folders open and allow cancelling with Escape or Back.
Avoid activating dormant automounts from directory monitoring.
Add a stable framed spinner and an empty-folder state.
